r01-ana-bike.observed_description: Ana (sage-green overshirt, jeans) rides a light-blue city bike with a basket holding a rolled blue towel along a quiet residential street.
r01-ana-bike.note: Usable: clearly riding a bike; the centered 4:5 crop trims part of the front wheel, the bike still reads.

r02-diego-bus.observed_description: Diego (burgundy shirt, laptop bag) stands in the open front door of a long white-and-blue city bus, one hand on the yellow handrail.
r02-diego-bus.note: Usable for by bus; note: facing out of the door, he could read as getting off rather than on (on/off is not taught here). Small accessibility icons on the bus, no letters.

r03-luis-car.observed_description: Luis (navy T-shirt) drives a dark-red hatchback, seen through the open driver's window, both hands on the wheel, a black sports bag on the passenger seat.
r03-luis-car.note: Usable: clearly driving a car; note: his hair is straighter and shorter than in his q01 reference (same deviation accepted for 1.7 h04).
